name: Hold the Line
description: While pinned to your King, destroy an adjacent diagonal enemy in-place.
image_description: A stone chess Pawn bracing a heavy tower shield against a glowing red laser beam aimed at a shadowy King behind it, while thrusting a spear sideways to shatter an adjacent black Knight.

name: Bayonet Charge
description: When blocked with 0 moves, capture the enemy piece directly in front (promotes on rank 8).
image_description: A white Pawn locked nose-to-nose with a towering black Rook on a tight chessboard tile, igniting a glowing energy blade from its helmet to cleave straight forward through the Rook's stone armor.

name: Sweeping Halberd
description: Advance 1 square into an enemy-controlled tile and capture an adjacent enemy left or right.
image_description: A Pawn stepping boldly onto a tile marked with glowing red crosshairs, swinging a wide crescent halberd horizontally to slice through an enemy Bishop standing on the square beside it.

name: Sniper Shot
description: Destroy a defended enemy on a forward diagonal from range without moving.
image_description: A hooded Pawn kneeling on a raised marble square, firing a bright bolt of light from a crossbow diagonally across a tile to shatter a black Bishop while an enemy Queen watches from the background.

name: Pike Thrust
description: Leap over an adjacent forward ally to capture an enemy 2 squares straight ahead.
image_description: A Pawn leveling an elongated glowing pike straight over the shoulder of a crouching allied Knight in front of it, impaling an unsuspecting black Pawn two squares away.

name: Close the Gap
description: While pinned to King, slide up to 2 empty squares along the pin ray toward the attacker.
image_description: A white Pawn leaning forward into a blinding beam of purple magic cast by a distant black Queen, skating two squares diagonally up the beam with sparks flying from its base.

name: Sidestep
description: When blocked with fewer than 2 legal moves, step 1 square left or right onto an empty square.
image_description: A Pawn facing a massive stone wall directly ahead on its file, smoothly dashing sideways onto an adjacent open file leaving an afterimage blur behind.

name: Tactical Retreat
description: When both forward diagonals are enemy-controlled, step 1 square backward onto an empty tile.
image_description: Two dark red shadow blades crossing over the tiles in front of a white Pawn as the Pawn hops one tile backward into safety with its shield raised.

name: Feint Step
description: When one diagonal target is defended, move 1 square forward onto the other diagonal if empty.
image_description: A Pawn lunging toward an armored black Knight on its left as a distraction, while its true translucent form slips diagonally right onto an open sunlit square.

name: Flank March
description: When blocked by an ally directly ahead, step 1 square diagonally forward onto an empty square.
image_description: A white Bishop standing still in the center of a lane while an agile white Pawn darts diagonally out from behind the Bishop's robes onto an open flanking square.

name: Call Reserves
description: When beside an ally, spawn a fresh Pawn on the empty square directly behind this Pawn.
image_description: A veteran Pawn blowing a brass war horn beside a towering allied Rook while a new marble Pawn materializes out of golden light on the tile directly behind it.

name: Reinforce Chain
description: When diagonal to an allied Pawn, spawn a fresh Pawn on the empty square behind the forward Pawn.
image_description: Two white Pawns linked by a glowing blue chain of energy across a diagonal, pulling a third newly formed Pawn up from the floorboards into the pocket behind them.

name: Royal Levy
description: When adjacent to your King, spawn a fresh Pawn on an empty square adjacent to your King.
image_description: A crowned King tapping his scepter on the board beside a loyal Pawn, causing an armored guard Pawn to rise from a glowing crest on an adjacent square.

name: Second Wave
description: When beside an allied Pawn, resurrect a captured Pawn directly behind either Pawn.
image_description: Two Pawns standing shoulder-to-shoulder with locked shields while a spectral, cracked Pawn rises from the ground behind them and reforms into solid white stone.

name: Militia Muster
description: When 3 Pawns hold adjacent files within 1 rank, resurrect up to 2 Pawns on your 2nd rank.
image_description: Three Pawns raising banners in a wedge formation at the center of the board while twin pillars of light on the home rank behind them forge two fresh Pawns.

name: Raise Buckler
description: When attacked and undefended, gain a kinetic shield until your next turn.
image_description: An isolated white Pawn surrounded by dark menacing shadows, projecting a dome of golden hexagonal forcefields that deflects an incoming black Rook's hammer.

name: King's Duel
description: When checking the enemy King, gain a shield against all non-King pieces for 1 turn.
image_description: A fearless Pawn pointing a glowing sword at a cornered black King while a ring of blue flames around the Pawn blocks an enemy Knight and Bishop from intervening.

name: Iron Wedge
description: When threatening 2 or more enemy pieces, gain a 1-turn shield against those threatened pieces.
image_description: A white Pawn wedged between a black Rook and a black Knight, projecting twin angled energy barriers that lock both enemy pieces' weapons in place.

name: Corner the Prey
description: When threatening an enemy Rook or Queen, place an impassable 1-turn wall adjacent to that target.
image_description: A Pawn aiming a glowing harpoon at a panicked black Queen while a crystalline wall of blue light erupts on the open square behind her, cutting off her retreat.

name: Trench Barricade
description: When contested in crossfire, place an impassable 2-turn wall on the empty square directly ahead.
image_description: A Pawn hunkered down in the middle of a fiery crossfire between two armies, slamming a device into the tile ahead to deploy a tall neon-blue blast shield.

name: Flank Tunnel
description: From a corner flank (a2/a7/h2/h7), leap across to the opposite rim file if empty.
image_description: A white Pawn at the corner edge of the chessboard stepping into a swirling violet portal on the a-file and emerging instantly from a matching portal on the h-file.

name: Vaulting Advance
description: From a central square (d4/d5/e4/e5), leap forward like a Knight onto an empty square.
image_description: A Pawn standing on a glowing central pedestal tile, using a pole-vault of light to leap in an L-shaped arc high over a line of enemy pieces.

name: Catapult Launch
description: From rank 2 with an ally directly behind, leap 3 squares forward onto an empty rank-5 square.
image_description: A heavy Rook on the back rank launching a curled-up white Pawn from a mechanical spring catapult, sending it soaring over the mid-board traffic onto the 5th rank.

name: Inward Bound
description: From the rim (a/h file), leap 2 squares inward toward the center onto an empty square.
image_description: A Pawn kicking off the crumbling outer rim of the chessboard, bounding sideways over a black Knight on the b-file to land squarely in the inner lanes.

name: Hit and Run
description: When capturing in enemy territory, immediately recoil back to your starting square.
image_description: A white Pawn deep in dark territory shattering a black Bishop with a dropkick and immediately backflipping in mid-air back onto its previous square.

name: Vanguard Tow
description: On an open file, advance 1 square and pull an ally directly behind into your vacated square.
image_description: A Pawn marching down a completely clear, sunlit marble corridor while towing a heavy white Rook directly behind it with chains of golden energy.

name: Signal Swap
description: When alone on your rank, swap positions with any other allied Pawn on the board.
image_description: A lone Pawn standing on an empty horizontal row holding up a glowing flare, trading places in a flash of lightning with a distant allied Pawn on the opposite side of the board.

name: Clear Sightline
description: On an open forward diagonal, an allied Bishop or Queen directly behind may leap over up to 3 squares.
image_description: A white Pawn bowing low as a glowing white Bishop behind it rockets over its head along a beam of light stretching down an unobstructed diagonal.

name: Vanguard Beckon
description: Face an enemy Pawn on the same file to pull it 1 or 2 squares forward toward your Pawn.
image_description: A white Pawn standing across an open file from a black Pawn, curling a glowing spectral hand that yanks the reluctant black Pawn two tiles forward out of its defensive line.

name: Ambush Switch
description: With an open line of sight to the enemy King, swap with an allied major piece on rank 1 or 2.
image_description: A white Pawn locking eyes with a distant black King down an open file as the Pawn dissolves into smoke, revealing a massive white Rook teleporting into its exact spot.

name: Cavalry Charge
description: Leap 3 squares straight and 1 to the side (Camel 3,1 vector) onto an empty square or to capture.
image_description: An armored white Knight rearing back on its starting marble pedestal before launching forward in a long, glowing golden arc high over two ranks of pieces onto the 4th rank.

name: Double Canter
description: Make a double Knight-jump in one turn (two consecutive leaps, capturing on both or either landing).
image_description: A white Knight mid-gallop touching down briefly on a glowing blue rune tile before immediately kicking off into a second L-shaped leap to strike an enemy Bishop.

name: Spring Vault
description: Leap 3 squares along one axis and 2 along the other (Zebra 3,2 vector) to jump or capture.
image_description: A moss-covered stone Knight cracking open with bright cyan energy, coiled like a spring before rocketing across five tiles of the board in a massive vault.

name: Tactical Disengage
description: Jump 2 squares orthogonally (Dabbaba 2,0 leap) over intervening pieces onto an empty square.
image_description: A white Knight with glowing red eyes swooping in to shatter a black Pawn with its hooves and instantly rebounding along a curved trail of light back to its previous tile.

name: Outrider Loop
description: Make a standard Knight leap onto an empty square and immediately recoil 1 square orthogonally.
image_description: A galloping Knight building up a trail of wind, leaping off the left edge of the chessboard into a dimensional rift and emerging at full stride from the right edge.

name: Stable Swap
description: From your starting square, swap positions with an allied Knight, Bishop, or Rook on rank 1.
image_description: A white Knight leaping forward out of its starting gate while a heavy white Rook smoothly slides sideways along a glowing track into the Knight's vacated square.

name: Relay Switch
description: If this Knight moved last turn, swap positions with an allied non-King piece within a Knight jump.
image_description: A glowing white Knight and an allied Bishop connected by an L-shaped arc of blue lightning, trading places mid-air in a swirl of arcane sparks.

name: Saddle Carry
description: When unmoved for 3 turns, make a Knight leap and carry an adjacent allied Pawn to your vacated square.
image_description: An armored white Pawn riding on the back of a rearing white Knight, hopping down onto the Knight's starting square as the steed leaps forward into battle.

name: Breach Follow-Up
description: After capturing last turn, leap to an empty square and advance a defender into your vacated square.
image_description: A victorious Knight bounding deeper into enemy lines while a white Queen surges forward along a golden slipstream to claim the exact tile the Knight just left.

name: Draft Slipstream
description: If moved on the last 2 turns, leap to an empty square and advance an adjacent allied Pawn 1 square forward.
image_description: A speeding white Knight kicking up a tailwind of glowing silver energy that pulls a nearby allied Pawn one tile forward in its wake.

name: Ray Intercept
description: While pinned to King, slide 1–2 squares along the pin ray toward the pinning attacker.
image_description: A white Knight lowering its armored head into a searing red laser beam aimed at its King, charging two squares straight up the beam to ram an enemy Bishop.

name: Cornered Dash
description: When having 2 or fewer legal moves, slide 1–2 empty squares diagonally in any open direction.
image_description: A boxed-in white Knight trapped near the edge of the board pivoting sharply and skating two tiles diagonally across the dark squares to break free.

name: Side Trot
description: When at least 3 moves are contested, step 1 square orthogonally onto an empty safe square.
image_description: Glowing red crosshairs targeting the L-shaped landing zones around a white Knight as the horse calmly steps one square sideways onto a safe, unlit tile.

name: Straight Lance
description: When threatening a defended enemy, lunge 2 squares orthogonally over an empty square to capture.
image_description: A Knight ignoring a heavily guarded black Rook on its flank and couch-lancing two squares straight down an open file to strike an exposed black Bishop.

name: Formation Stride
description: When 2 jump squares are blocked by allies, step 1 square orthogonally then make a Knight jump.
image_description: A white Knight weaving one step through a crowded phalanx of allied Pawns before launching into a full L-shaped leap over the frontline.

name: Parting Kick
description: When attacked, make a Knight leap and destroy an adjacent enemy minor piece at your vacated square.
image_description: A white Knight bucking its hind legs to shatter an adjacent black Bishop as it vaults away onto a safe square in a shower of stone fragments.

name: Trampling Check
description: When leaping to deliver check, destroy an enemy Pawn standing on the corner elbow of your leap.
image_description: A charging white Knight leaping over a black Pawn's head, crushing the Pawn with downward hooves of light before landing to point its lance at the black King.

name: Twin Javelin
description: When forking 2 or more enemy pieces, destroy the lowest-value non-King target from range.
image_description: A white Knight perched on a central square between a black Rook and Bishop, hurling a bolt of lightning that shatters the Bishop while keeping its eyes locked on the Rook.

name: Dragoon Dive
description: When threatening an enemy Rook or Queen, leap to capture an adjacent enemy Pawn or minor piece.
image_description: A Knight feinting a dive toward a black Queen before banking sharply in mid-air to crush the black Knight standing guard directly beside her.

name: Jousting Pass
description: When contested in crossfire, make a Knight leap and destroy an enemy Pawn on the path elbow square.
image_description: A white Knight caught in a crossfire of arrows lunging past a black Pawn, slicing through the Pawn with a glowing saber as it lands on an open square.

name: Bastion Stance
description: Starting or ending on a corner square, gain a kinetic shield until the start of your next turn.
image_description: A white Knight leaping out from a stone corner watchtower wrapped in a shimmering silver aura that deflects incoming dark magic.

name: Drop Caltrops
description: From a central square, place impassable 1-turn walls on up to 2 adjacent empty orthogonal squares.
image_description: A Knight rearing up in the center of the board, scattering glowing blue energy spikes onto the two squares beside it that erupt into tall crystalline barriers.

name: Stable Barricade
description: From rank 1, grant a 1-turn kinetic shield to an allied piece currently defended by this Knight.
image_description: A Knight on the home rank projecting an L-shaped arc of golden light forward to wrap an allied central Pawn in a protective dome.

name: Flank Palisade
description: From the rim (a/h file), place an impassable 2-turn wall on any empty square within a Knight jump.
image_description: A Knight stationed on the outer rim of the board firing an energy beacon two files inward, raising a glowing holographic wall in front of an advancing black Rook.

name: Raider's Aegis
description: In enemy territory, leap to an empty square, leave a 1-turn wall behind, and gain a shield against Pawns.
image_description: A Knight deep in enemy territory leaping to a new square as a wall of blue fire rises on its previous tile and enemy Pawns' spears bounce off its glowing armor.

name: Summon Squire
description: When beside an ally, spawn a fresh Pawn on an empty square orthogonally adjacent to this Knight.
image_description: A white Knight standing beside a white Rook, tapping its hoof on an empty adjacent tile to summon an armored squire Pawn from a circle of light.

name: Flank Recruit
description: When diagonal to an ally, leap to an empty square and spawn a fresh Pawn on your vacated square.
image_description: A Knight leaping forward from beside an allied Bishop, leaving behind a swirling dust cloud that solidifies into a fresh white Pawn on the vacated tile.

name: King's Outrider
description: When adjacent to your King, resurrect a captured Pawn onto an empty square a Knight jump from King.
image_description: A white Knight bowing before the King as a beam of royal golden light arcs outward in an L-shape, reviving a fallen Pawn on a forward defensive square.

name: Cavalry Remount
description: When both Knights defend each other, spawn up to 2 fresh Pawns adjacent to either Knight.
image_description: Two white Knights rearing up across an L-shaped tether of crackling silver energy while two fresh Pawns materialize beside their flanks.

name: Banner Rally
description: When adjacent to 2 allied Pawns, resurrect a captured Pawn on rank 2 or 3 in the same file.
image_description: A Knight raising a war banner between two frontline Pawns as a spectral Pawn reforms into solid marble on the home file behind them.

name: File Smite
description: Slide along an open rank or file to capture an enemy piece orthogonally up to 3 squares away.
image_description: A white Bishop standing in a wide, pawn-free marble corridor, raising its crosier to call down a vertical pillar of golden light onto a black Knight three tiles ahead.

name: Bishop Cleave
description: Slide diagonally up to 2 squares and destroy all adjacent enemy Pawns on arrival.
image_description: A Bishop drawing power from an empty horizontal rank before gliding diagonally to shatter a black Rook, releasing a sideways shockwave that crumbles an adjacent black Pawn.

name: Piercing Ray
description: Slide along a diagonal, capturing an enemy piece and destroying the piece immediately behind it.
image_description: A white Bishop channeling energy from an open cross-diagonal and transforming into a beam of pure white laser light, blasting straight through a black Pawn to strike the black Bishop behind it.

name: Mirror Shatter
description: When pinned, destroy the pinning piece and all enemy pieces adjacent to it.
image_description: A white Bishop and a black Bishop locked in a glaring duel down a long diagonal as the white Bishop steps one tile back and fires a prism beam that shatters its dark counterpart.

name: Bishop Smite
description: Target an enemy piece within 2 squares diagonally and destroy it from range without moving.
image_description: A Bishop spotting the enemy King down an open file, darting diagonally into a checking square while a ring of radiant light bursts outward to vaporize a nearby black Pawn.

name: Orthogonal Glide
description: Slide 1–3 empty squares orthogonally along an open rank or file without capturing.
image_description: A white Bishop floating serenely down the center of an unobstructed vertical file, shifting from a dark marble tile onto a glowing light marble tile.

name: Color Shift
description: Step 1 square along your rank to change square color, then make a standard diagonal slide.
image_description: A dark-squared Bishop sidestepping along an empty rank onto a bright white tile, its robes glowing gold as it launches down a brand-new light-squared diagonal.

name: Aisle Step
description: On an open diagonal, step 1 square orthogonally onto an empty tile, inverting square color.
image_description: A Bishop standing at the crossroads of an empty diagonal, calmly stepping one tile sideways across the border from a dark square onto an adjacent light square.

name: Heretic's Gambit
description: When facing an enemy Bishop, make a Knight jump onto an empty square, permanently shifting color.
image_description: A white Bishop facing down a rival black Bishop, breaking formation to leap in a glowing L-shaped arc over a Pawn onto a tile of the opposite color.

name: Royal Approach
description: With an open orthogonal line to enemy King, slide 1–2 empty squares directly toward the King.
image_description: A Bishop locking its gaze on the distant black King down an open rank, gliding two squares straight toward the monarch with its staff leveled.

name: Vaulting Escape
description: When attacked, leap over exactly 1 intervening piece along a diagonal onto an empty square.
image_description: An endangered white Bishop dodging a black Rook's charge by levitating gracefully over an allied Pawn's head to land far down the diagonal.

name: Skyward Check
description: Leap over a single intervening allied piece along a diagonal to deliver check to enemy King.
image_description: A white Bishop soaring on wings of light over the shoulder of an allied Knight, touching down on a forward diagonal to aim a beam of check at the enemy King.

name: Recoil Hop
description: When forking 2 pieces, capture one and immediately recoil back along the diagonal to your square.
image_description: A white Bishop positioned between two enemy pieces darting up-left to shatter a black Knight and instantly rewinding along a golden trail back to its center perch.

name: Overpass Leap
description: When threatening a Rook or Queen, leap directly over it onto the empty diagonal square behind.
image_description: A nimble white Bishop somersaulting over the crown of a startled black Queen along a glowing diagonal path to land safely on the tile behind her.

name: Horizon Wrap
description: In crossfire on the rim, slide diagonally off the board edge and wrap around to the opposite rim.
image_description: A Bishop under heavy fire gliding off the left edge of the chessboard into a stained-glass portal and emerging on the right edge on a matching-color tile.

name: Cleric's Ward
description: When beside an allied non-King piece, grant it a kinetic shield until the start of your next turn.
image_description: A white Bishop laying a glowing hand on the shoulder of an adjacent white Knight, wrapping the steed in a shimmering dome of golden stained-glass light.

name: Prism Wall
description: When diagonal to an ally, place an impassable 2-turn wall on an adjacent empty diagonal square.
image_description: A Bishop standing diagonally behind an allied Pawn, raising its staff to erect a tall, glowing stained-glass barrier on the open diagonal square beside it.

name: Cathedral Dome
description: Beside King or Queen, grant both pieces a 1-turn shield against captures from 2+ squares away.
image_description: A white Bishop standing beside the white Queen under a vaulted cathedral arch of blue light that deflects a distant black Rook's artillery beam.

name: Twin Sanctuary
description: With both Bishops within 2 squares, place 2-turn walls on up to 2 empty diagonal squares.
image_description: A light-squared and dark-squared Bishop standing side by side, crossing their staffs to project two interlocking holographic walls across the center of the board.

name: Blessed Phalanx
description: Behind a diagonal chain of 2+ allied Pawns, grant the front Pawn a shield until your next turn.
image_description: A Bishop at the base of a three-piece diagonal column sending a wave of golden light through the middle Pawn to encase the lead Pawn in an impenetrable shield.

name: Belfry Acolyte
description: From a corner square, spawn a fresh allied Pawn on the empty diagonally adjacent square.
image_description: A Bishop tucked deep inside a corner bell-tower square, summoning a fresh marble Pawn onto the fianchetto square directly in front of it.

name: Conclave Summon
description: From a central square, spawn up to 2 fresh Pawns on empty diagonally adjacent squares.
image_description: A white Bishop radiating light from a central square as two new white Pawns materialize out of glowing sigils on its diagonal flanks.

name: Altar Revival
description: From rank 1, resurrect a captured Pawn on rank 2 or 3 along an open diagonal of this Bishop.
image_description: A Bishop on the home rank chanting over a glowing altar, sending a beam of light two tiles diagonally forward to reassemble a shattered Pawn.

name: Cloister Initiate
description: From the rim (a/h file), spawn a fresh Pawn on the empty square orthogonally inward.
image_description: A Bishop perched on the outer rim of the board gesturing inward as a new white Pawn steps out of a column of light onto the adjacent inner file.

name: Recruit Pawn
description: In enemy territory, resurrect a captured Pawn on an empty square diagonally behind this Bishop.
image_description: A white Bishop deep in dark territory raising its staff as a fallen Pawn rises from the shadows on the diagonal tile directly behind it.

name: Part the Crowd
effect_exact: Pawn Diagonal Step and Bishop Exit
description: From start square, step a blocking diagonal Pawn forward 1 square, then slide this Bishop.
image_description: A starting-rank Pawn stepping diagonally aside to bow as a white Bishop glides swiftly past it down the newly opened diagonal lane.

name: Diagonal Tow
description: If moved last turn, pull an ally on an open diagonal 1–2 squares along that diagonal toward you.
image_description: A glowing white Bishop extending a tether of golden light down a diagonal to reel an allied Queen two tiles closer to its position.

name: Diagonal Swap
description: When unmoved for 3 turns, swap positions with any same-color-complex allied minor piece or Pawn.
image_description: A meditative white Bishop surrounded by floating runes trading places in a beam of starlight with a distant allied Knight standing on a matching-color tile.

name: Fervor Push
description: After capturing last turn, slide diagonally and push an adjacent allied Pawn 1 square forward.
image_description: A battle-lit Bishop sweeping onto a square behind an allied Pawn, sending a gust of radiant wind that propels the Pawn one tile forward.

name: Pilgrim Escort
description: If moved on last 2 turns, slide diagonally carrying an adjacent Pawn along a parallel diagonal.
image_description: A white Bishop and an adjacent white Pawn gliding in synchronized parallel diagonal trails of golden light across the middle of the board.
